subject: general
question: ‘Sea of Poppies’ is a novel written by which of the following writers?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Amitav Ghosh__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Sea of Poppies is a novel by Indian novelist** Amitav Ghosh which was shortlisted for the Man Booker Prize in 2008.**
 
• It is the first volume of the** lbis trilogy.**
 
• In the words of **Rajnish Mishra, "the lbis trilogy is Ghosh's most vehement indictment of the source of imperialism and colonialism".​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Shashi Tharoor** has been serving as a Member of Parliament.
 
• **Manohar Malgonkar **was an Indian author.
 
• **Anuj Dhar **is an Indian author and former journalist. ** **
